capabilities: Render invisible Unicode characters as inline color-coded glyphs in Source mode and Live Preview
Clear marks from the whole note, a selection, or the current block with a confirm modal and single-step undo
Jump to the next or previous mark, selecting and scrolling it into view
Pick unknown codepoints and assign category-based removal actions
Mark and optionally clear base64 tracking tokens
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese UI that follows Obsidian's language; all features work on mobile except the status-bar counter. Installable from the official community plugin store or via BRAT.
problem: Web clipping leaves hidden characters (zero-width marks, exotic spaces, bidi controls) that silently break search matching, wikilinks, git diffs, and copy-pasted code.

relations.evidence: When you clip web pages into Obsidian with the Web Clipper, some sites slip invisible watermark characters into the text

summary: Character inspector that reveals invisible Unicode watermark characters in clipped notes and removes them with confirmable, undoable actions.
